model: ALE3 three-phase 65 A energy meter (Modbus RTU)
applies_to: ALE3 unidirectional (ALE3D5FD10C3A00) and bidirectional (ALE3B5FD00C3A00) Modbus types, assembly and operating instructions 431951130.
summary: The ALE3 is a Saia Burgess Controls DIN-rail three-phase active energy meter for direct connection up to 65 A, with an RS-485 Modbus RTU interface. Baud rate and parity are detected automatically. This map covers identification, status and error registers, the two total and two resettable partial energy counters, and per-phase voltage and current.

addressing.note: The register list numbers registers from 1, and the manual states that register R is sent as R - 1: register 28 (energy total) is wire address 27.

source.title: ALE3 Modbus - Assembly and operating instructions (unidirectional ALE3D5FD10, bidirectional ALE3B5FD00)
source.pages: English register list and Modbus technical data, PDF page 2

notes: This is an unaltered copy of the SBC instruction sheet posted on the Viessmann community forum; an official public SBC URL for this revision was not found in the time available.
The sheet lists the double registers sent high register first (big-endian, ABCD) as 4-5, 16-17, 28-29, 30-31 and 32-33. Example from the sheet: high 13, low 60383 = 912351 = 9123.51 kWh.
Energy counters are 0.01 kWh per count. Voltage is 1 V per count, current 0.1 A per count.

On the unidirectional type registers 28-35 are tariff 1 and tariff 2 counters. On the bidirectional type the sheet's display section describes the second counter set as feed-back (delivered) energy; the tariff register's arrows mark direction.

Left out: active and reactive power and cos phi per phase and total (registers 38-40, 43-45, 48-52), because the sheet does not say whether these 16-bit values are signed, which matters on the bidirectional type; the serial number (16-18), whose word layout is printed inconsistently; type/ASN text registers 7-14.
Left out: partial energy WT2 (registers 34-35). The sheet names it a resettable partial counter but leaves it off its list of high-register-first pairs, so its word order is not stated.
Only functions 03 and 16 are accepted, and at most 20 registers per request.
Serial format: baud rate (4800-115200) and parity are auto-detected; even or odd parity use 1 stop bit, no parity uses 2 stop bits.

registers.name: Counter total energy WT1
registers.description: Tariff 1 total; see notes for the bidirectional type.

registers.name: Counter partial energy WT1
registers.description: Resettable: write 0 to both registers in one FC16 message.

registers.name: Counter total energy WT2
registers.description: Tariff 2 total; see notes for the bidirectional type.

integration.summary: Read holding registers 28-33 (wire 27-32) for the energy counters as 32-bit high-word-first values in 0.01 kWh, and 36-47 for voltages and currents; keep each request at 20 registers or fewer.
integration.enable: Set the Modbus address on the meter (press the touch key for 3 s, then step the address) or write register 24; baud rate and parity are detected automatically.
quirks: Register R is wire address R - 1.
Max 20 registers per read; only FC03 and FC16.
Address register cannot be written by broadcast.
setup: The interface has no built-in terminating resistor; fit one externally.
Up to 247 meters per bus; use a repeater beyond 128.
gotchas: Reset partial counter WT1 by writing 0 to both of its registers (30-31) in one FC16 message.
Data refreshes every 10 s; the sheet advises not polling one meter faster than that.
The interface works only with phase 1 connected and answers 30 s after power-up.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
